summary: Tests-only run for issue #39. Vendored the real solver parity corpus from viamin/color_matching (priv/parity/v1/corpus.json, byte-identical, 12 scenarios) and added a permanent parity test target replaying every scenario through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer (scores, exclusions, earliest-index-wins ties, winning error, selected hex). Added PaletteAPIClient wire-contract tests pinning /api/v1 behavior for the generated-client migration, plus two red-by-design guard tests (OpenAPI client adoption, README corpus documentation) and docs/solver-parity-corpus.md. Swift toolchain is unavailable in this container (swift: command not found; configured test command is a no-op echo), so tests could not be executed here; an independent Python replay of the scorer algorithm matched all 12 corpus scenarios exactly (inspectable in this run's transcript), and the Swift tests were written strictly against the existing public API of ColorComposerCore. Red-phase assertion failures in GeneratedOpenAPIClientAdoptionTests and CorpusDocumentationTests are the expected demonstrations of missing behavior for the implementation run.
